summary: Full backend + frontend testing of POP Monitoring app. 24/24 pytest backend tests PASS covering auth (admin/operator/viewer + httpOnly cookies + invalid creds), RBAC (viewer blocked from POP create & settings PUT -> 403; operator blocked from DELETE -> 403; operator can run check), CRUD POP+Link (with distance_km haversine computed, update persisted, admin delete, 404 after delete, no password_enc/snmp_community_enc/_id leak), dashboard summary KPIs, topology graph, settings, map-settings, and the CRITICAL topology-engine scenarios: (a) interface fault on POP-A ether2 -> LINK-AB=DOWN/INTERFACE_DOWN while all 5 POPs remain UP via alternative path B-C-D-A; (b) adding POP-C ether1 cut -> POP-B isolated DOWN/LINK_UNREACHABLE while A/C/D/E UP; (c) POP-B router_down=true -> POP-B DOWN/ROUTER_DOWN and its links UNKNOWN/ROUTER_DOWN (never falsely 'cut'); state restored after each scenario. Alerts list + operator resolve verified. Frontend: login works, invalid-password error renders, admin dashboard shows 5 POP cards with live metrics + KPIs + event feed (incl. ALT_PATH 'tetap reachable melalui jalur alternatif.' informational events), topology React Flow renders 5 nodes & 5 edges, map page renders Leaflet with 5 markers & 5 polylines, Settings page toggles provider osm<->google, viewer logged in cannot see Add POP button (RBAC enforced on UI), monitoring run-check-btn works, LIVE indicator present.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning: 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.' repeating on multiple pages. LIVE indicator still appears green (likely via periodic HTTP refresh or reconnect loop), but real-time push via WS appears broken through the ingress on this preview environment. Needs verification whether the ingress config allows ws upgrade on /api/ws.

issues: Default OSM tile style is 'CARTO Dark Matter' which now serves a huge diagonal 'API KEY REQUIRED - carto.com/basemaps/apikey' watermark on every tile, making the map unreadable out-of-the-box. The 'OpenStreetMap' option in Settings -> OSM Tile Style works correctly without a key. Recommendation: change DEFAULT_MAP_SETTINGS.osm_tile in /app/backend/db.py from 'cartodb_dark' to 'osm' (standard OSM), or sign up for a Carto basemaps API key. User-facing promise 'No API key. Leaflet + OSM/CARTO tiles.' is currently false for the default pick.

action_items: Change default osm_tile from 'cartodb_dark' to 'osm' in /app/backend/db.py DEFAULT_MAP_SETTINGS so first-run map isn't covered by 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark (CARTO policy change).

Investigate /api/ws WebSocket upgrade through the preview ingress (console warns 'closed before established'). Dashboard still updates via periodic refresh/polling, so this is non-blocking but reduces real-time UX.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) directly; a malformed sub will raise bson.errors.InvalidId -> uncaught 500 instead of 401. Wrap in try/except.
api.py set_auth_cookies hardcodes samesite='none' + secure=True; fine for cross-site preview URL, but ensure production env flag or env-driven override. No action for now.

api.py login_attempts logic sets 'locked_until' to the current timestamp (not a future time) so the 429 branch is effectively never triggered (locked < now always true). The 5-attempt brute-force lockout as advertised in playbook test is NOT functional.

monitor.py _collect falls back to simulation if sim.enabled OR no mikrotik_ip; but the condition `sim.get('enabled', True) or not pop.get('mikrotik_ip')` means seeded POPs with mikrotik_ip still simulate because enabled=True — correct per user choice, but a POP with enabled=False and no IP will attempt real ping on empty IP; guard already handles via _real_ping returning unreachable. OK.
api.py create_pop stores password_enc/snmp_community_enc from encrypt_secret(''), returning '' — benign.
No pagination on /api/alerts beyond limit param; fine for MVP.

None block the MVP acceptance tests; mention when re-running security playbook.
